outcome: prenatal diagnosis of sex chromosome aneuploidy (SCA)
percentage of prenatal diagnostic tests leading to a SCA diagnosis
annual prenatal diagnosis rate of SCA
cohort: The study included all women undergoing prenatal diagnosis before 25 weeks gestation in the Australian state of Victoria from 1986 to 2016, encompassing over 2 million births.
finding: After the introduction of NIPT, sex chromosome aneuploidies increased as a proportion of prenatal diagnostic results, but the overall prenatal prevalence rate remained steady due to a concurrent decline in diagnostic testing.
